title: A project's airgap settings (testing/airgap.yaml)
description: What the airgap agent allows in one project, beyond the machine itself, and how it treats production profiles. Words follow GLOSSARY.md.

mode.description: refuse: stop every call not allowed (the default). report: let every call go ahead, and record it. off: neither.

target.description: host:port (localhost:8089), a host on its own, a JDBC or HTTP URL prefix, process:name for a program, or native:name for a native library.

reason.description: What the stand-in is, for example "WireMock standing in for the postcode service".

production_profiles.description: Spring profile names that mean production. A run with any of them active stops at once.

file_writes.description: Whether writes to files outside the project are only reported (the default) or refused.
